name: Final Count
game_text:
Plays to your support area.
Each time Legolas wins a skirmish, you may place an <culture>Elven</culture> token on this card.
While you can spot X <culture>Elven</culture> tokens on this card and the same number of <culture>Dwarven</culture> tokens on My Axe Is Notched, Legolas is strength +X (limit +3).
